raw: {"analysis":"PGK provides a more actionable and technically sound plan. It correctly identifies the need for a local rate limiter (token bucket at 490 RPS) to avoid IP bans, proposes a targeted regression suite to save CI time and cost, and includes a canary rollout strategy. WJB raises a valid concern about the fail-open fallback being a security risk, but PGK implicitly addresses this by having the Head of Trust & Safety review the decision logic. WJB's plan is less concrete on implementation details and doesn't address the rate limit as proactively. PGK also correctly handles the rollback irreversibility by noting that created users cannot be deleted by a simple revert.","verdict":"PGK"}
